ideas.pitch: A high-performance asynchronous web scraper using pure Python standard libraries, Requests, and BeautifulSoup without heavy browser automation.
ideas.problem_statement: Solve a technical challenge involving analysing web pages and HTML structures, extracting relevant data, writing Python scraping scripts, processing extracted information, and handling edge cases.
ideas.title: RequestsSoup Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Strict compliance with the challenge rules prohibiting Selenium and Playwright, focusing entirely on raw HTTP requests, speed, and robust HTML parsing efficiency.

ideas.pitch: A specialized data extraction pipeline that robustly parses complex unstructured HTML tables and uses advanced regex for clean data normalization.
ideas.problem_statement: Solve a technical challenge involving extracting relevant data, writing Python scraping scripts, processing extracted information, and handling edge cases.
ideas.title: RobustRegex Data Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges will evaluate heavily on edge-case handling and data accuracy, which this pipeline targets directly through rigorous regex validation.

ideas.pitch: A resilient scraping utility featuring intelligent rate limiting, exponential backoff, proxy rotation simulation, and comprehensive error handling for blocked IPs.
ideas.problem_statement: Solve a technical challenge involving handling edge cases, scraping efficiency, and robust Python script development.
ideas.title: HTTP Fallback and Retry Scraper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Handles network failures and blocking edge cases gracefully, demonstrating superior engineering reliability compared to basic scripts.

ideas.pitch: An automated parser designed to extract embedded schema.org JSON-LD and microdata from complex e-commerce or directory web pages instantly.
ideas.problem_statement: Solve a technical challenge involving analysing web pages and HTML structures, and extracting relevant data efficiently.
ideas.title: JSON-LD & Microdata Extractor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages structured data parsing inside HTML headers, minimizing DOM traversal overhead and maximizing extraction speed.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight automated script using standard urllib and HTTP session cookies to navigate multi-step form submissions without browser overhead.
ideas.problem_statement: Solve a technical challenge involving web analysis, data extraction, processing, and automation without Selenium or Playwright.
ideas.title: Headless HTTP Automator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Strictly adheres to the anti-Selenium constraint while demonstrating advanced HTTP session handling and automation logic.
